review.notes: Machine-scanned all 48 physical pages with code-fence balance check (balanced; no swallowed headings/tables/images) and normalized 4-gram containment of each page's extracted text against the full OCR markdown; pages 6-12 misses were table cell-ordering artifacts (no missing words) and pages 39-42 are figure pages whose captions are present. Line-level focus on the footnote system: all 12 page-bottom footnote bodies (markers 1-12) are dropped in OCR and were re-transcribed from 300-dpi bottom-strip renders of pages 4, 5, 9, 10, 13, 15, 16, 18, 19, 21. Table 4's two-level header flattening and cell values were verified against the p.9 render and left unchanged (8 data columns match the print); page 47 contributor list and pages 39-42 figure captions were spot-checked for presence. Full word-by-word proofreading of body prose was not performed (machine scan only), so coverage is partial.
